architecture.title: APIs & Contracts
architecture.description: Full-cycle REST API design: requirements analysis, use case definition, OpenAPI/Swagger documentation, and production support. I prioritize contract clarity, versioning, and compatibility with mobile clients. I've designed and maintained APIs consumed by 3,000+ monthly active users in production.

cleanCode.title: Cloud & Architecture
cleanCode.description: Cloud-native architecture with Azure Functions and ASP.NET Core. I design systems with event-driven async processing using Azure Storage Queues and Worker Services. I evaluate deployment models, serverless vs App Service, analyzing operational cost, scalability, and latency based on each product's requirements.

performance.title: Security
performance.description: Security applied from the first commit, not as an afterthought. I implement stateless JWT authentication, endpoint-level RBAC, OAuth 2.0 with Google and Apple, and Redis-backed rate limiting against brute-force and credential-stuffing attacks. Background in SecDevOps in enterprise environments at Ernst & Young.

professionalism.title: Payments & Integrations
professionalism.description: Full Stripe integration: webhooks, idempotency, and subscription lifecycle management. Native subscriptions with Apple App Store and Google Play including server-side receipt validation. I've built payment systems in production that process real user transactions without incidents.

projects.title: Projects

prodigy.name: Prodigy Padel Academy
prodigy.description: Sports training platform for padel players, built around a proven 25-year methodology. Backend: gamification system (points, levels, achievements, leaderboards), Stripe payments, App Store and Google Play in-app purchases, optimized PostgreSQL architecture, Redis rate limiting, and JWT authentication with RBAC and OAuth 2.0.

koru.name: Koru Acne
koru.description: Mobile application for skin tracking and acne support community. Backend: REST API design, JWT and OAuth 2.0 authentication, database architecture for user management, visual skin tracking, trigger factor identification, and wellness resources.

dailydermatalks.name: DailyDermaTalks
dailydermatalks.description: Web platform for the Cantabria Labs dermatology community, with restricted access and controlled capacity: access is granted manually by an administrator. Full design and implementation: REST APIs, JWT authentication with role-based RBAC, CMS for content management, Upstash Redis rate limiting, and PostgreSQL database architecture. Deployed on Vercel.

galivivienda.name: Galivivienda VPO Calculator
galivivienda.description: Interactive calculator to analyze the real cost of a cooperative VPO housing unit in Vélez-Málaga, based on the public documentation for the Galivivienda Fortalezas de Vélez development (188 units, EMVIPSA). Built because the official information is fragmented across multiple contracts with unclear terms — lets users simulate different IPC scenarios, rental years, and discount percentages to calculate the actual total cost before signing. Implementation: real-time financial calculations with monthly compound interest, a rent evolution chart rendered with pure JS (no canvas or libraries), responsive design with adaptive grid and native mobile bottom-sheet, and full SEO with JSON-LD. Immediate organic traction when shared in local Facebook groups.

about.title: About
about.description: Backend Engineer with 4+ years of experience building and maintaining production systems. At The Bubble Hub I led backend development for two mobile products serving 3,000+ monthly active users. My work focuses on ASP.NET Core, Azure, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, and authentication and payment systems.

intro.paragraph1: At The Bubble Hub I owned the full backend engineering lifecycle for two mobile products serving 3,000+ monthly active users: requirements analysis, API contract design, data architecture, implementation, third-party integrations, and production support. I made technical decisions on architecture, data modeling, and security.
intro.paragraph2: The backend I designed covers layered security, event-driven async processing, and complex payment integrations with Stripe, App Store, and Google Play. Every architectural decision had direct impact on performance and user experience.
intro.paragraph3: Before this, at Ernst & Young I worked in enterprise environments with regulated software lifecycles and strict security requirements. That context, marked by SecDevOps, audits, and systems processing millions of daily events, shapes how I approach any design today: security applied from the first commit, not as an afterthought.
intro.paragraph4: I'm currently completing a Master's in Artificial Intelligence at UNIR, focused on backend system design and cloud-native architecture. I'm particularly interested in designing maintainable backend architectures, distributed systems, and cloud solutions capable of evolving over the long term.

bubbleHub.description: Led backend development for Prodigy Padel Academy and Koru: two mobile products serving 3,000+ monthly active users. Full ownership of the engineering lifecycle: requirements analysis, OpenAPI/Swagger contract design, implementation with ASP.NET Core and Azure Functions, payment integrations (Stripe, Apple IAP, Google Play), and production support. Optimized PostgreSQL architecture, JWT/RBAC/OAuth 2.0 authentication, Redis rate limiting, async processing with Azure Storage Queues, and CI/CD pipelines with SonarCloud in Azure DevOps.

ey.description: Backend development and SecDevOps in enterprise environments with regulated software lifecycles. ASP.NET components with security applied by design: input validation, data encryption, least-privilege access control. CI/CD pipeline optimization with Jenkins and GitHub Actions. Integration of 10+ security sources into SIEM platforms (IBM QRadar, Splunk, Wazuh).
